exit_codes.3: ownership, plan, lock, or recovery conflict

guarantees: no shell execution or downloads during generation
JSON mode emits one envelope, including failures
add rejects changed existing contracts; change performs explicit contract regeneration without migrating business behavior

policy.application: own domain/application packages and platform fault/validate; no transport, persistence, filesystem, or peer business imports
policy.composition: ordinary constructors, operation-specific dependency structs, bootstrap.Wire
policy.cross_module: consumer-owned interfaces injected at composition; no direct peer module imports
policy.domain: permitted standard-library packages only; no framework, transport, database, filesystem, or peer business imports
global_checks: no unsafe, cgo, or plugin imports
generated content must match canonical output
strict mode rejects pending scaffolds and test skips
limitations: structural checks do not prove business correctness, authorization, transactional safety, or concurrency safety
not a sandbox or defense against deliberate checker/CI edits
generated API is unauthenticated and loopback-only by default
explicit contract regeneration is supported; business-behavior migrations and CLI-version upgrades are not automatic
policy.ownership: CLI owns contracts, routes, generated wiring, runtime and agent instructions; developers own behavior, ports, adapters and business tests
policy.persistence: postgres adapter; pgx/v5 import family allowed; adapter and SQL generation not yet supplied
policy.transport: net/http; GET queries; POST commands; JSON; explicit generated registration
